description: This file defines a subclass of AccessibilityService named MagnificationService that controls display magnification using volume keys, listens for magnification changes, and manages accessibility events related to magnification and key events.

classes.name: MagnificationService
classes.description: A custom AccessibilityService that responds to volume key presses to adjust display magnification and listens for magnification change events.

methods.name: onAccessibilityEvent
methods.description: Callback for accessibility events; currently does nothing.

methods.name: onInterrupt
methods.description: Handles interruption requests; currently does nothing.

methods.name: onKeyEvent
methods.description: Handles key events to intercept volume keys and triggers magnification adjustments.

methods.name: handleVolumeKey
methods.description: Adjusts the magnification scale based on volume key presses.

methods.name: onServiceConnected
methods.description: Initializes the accessibility service, requests key event filtering, and sets up magnification change listener.
